steps.script: for source in process-*.c; do name=${source#process-}; cc -O0 "$source" -o "${name%.c}" || exit 1; done

steps.why: Two processes contend for flock and fcntl locks; a release wakes its waiter at once.
One read of a regular file returns the whole request, as programs assume.
A handler that leaves by siglongjmp or longjmp is over: the mask follows sigsetjmp, and later signals arrive.
exec replaces a process's program and keeps the process. What cannot run fails the call, the refused executable after one line on stderr.
A program rewritten in place runs as it now is: the supervisor reuses a compiled module only for the version of the file's bytes it came from.
steps.script: echo 'int main(void) { return 41; }' > again.c && cc again.c -o again && cp again again-41 && (./again; test $? = 41) && echo 'int main(void) { return 42; }' > again.c && cc again.c -o again && (./again; test $? = 42) && cat again-41 > again && (./again; test $? = 41)

steps.why: A program's own abort, here in an archive as SpiderMonkey's mozalloc has it, takes libc's place, as with a static libc.
steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <unistd.h>' 'void abort(void) { _exit(7); }' > own-abort.c && cc -c own-abort.c -o own-abort.o && ar rcs libown-abort.a own-abort.o && printf '%s\n' '#include <stdlib.h>' 'int main(void) { abort(); }' > calls-abort.c && cc calls-abort.c -L. -lown-abort -o calls-abort && (./calls-abort; test $? = 7)

steps.why: mprotect is the adapter's in a program that maps nothing and first reaches the system calls Emscripten's stubs answered (sync, getgroups).
steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <errno.h>' '#include <sys/mman.h>' '#include <unistd.h>' 'static char page[65536];' 'int main(void) { gid_t group; sync();' '  if (getgroups(0, NULL) != 1 || getgroups(1, &group) != 1 || group != 0) return 1;' '  return mprotect(page, sizeof page, PROT_READ) == -1 && errno == ENOTSUP ? 0 : 2; }' > protects.c && cc protects.c -o protects && ./protects

steps.why: Ninja runs its jobs at once: each of the two waits for the other to start.
steps.script: mkdir -p ninja && cd ninja && printf '%s\n' 'rule a' '  command = touch a-started; until test -e b-started; do sleep 1; done; touch $out' 'rule b' '  command = touch b-started; until test -e a-started; do sleep 1; done; touch $out' 'rule fail' '  command = exit 3' 'build a: a' 'build b: b' 'build failed: fail' > build.ninja && timeout 60 ninja -j2 a b > /dev/null && test -e a && test -e b
git config --file /tmp/dolly-process-test/config user.email before && timeout 5 git config --file /tmp/dolly-process-test/config user.email after
